review: One dark world, one canvas. The network graph fills the screen while a slim left rail works like a card catalogue and a right dossier panel reads like a case file. Lime green is the only loud color and it marks what matters: totals, keywords, active states. Type pairs a grotesk for headlines with a mono for every number and label, which fits an investigation database. Mode pills along the bottom reframe the same data six ways without leaving the page. Worth stealing: the staggered file tabs, the money stat blocks, and the restraint of a single accent color.
